page_title: Practical Magic 2: Box Office or Bust
date_caption: Created September 14, 2026 for the 38th week of 2026.

news.title: ‘Practical Magic 2’ Brews Up $46M WW In Global Opening - Deadline

weekly_forecast: Practical Magic 2's $46M opening is about as magical as a wet match. Next week, desperate Warner Bros. execs will try to blame the flop on Mercury retrograde. The film's stars will mysteriously vanish from social media, only to reappear promoting a surprise reboot of Hocus Pocus. Meanwhile, fans will start a Change.org petition to remake the movie with Nicolas Cage as every character.

signs.name: Aries
lines: You’ll storm out of the theater demanding a refund after 10 minutes.
Then you’ll apologize and buy tickets for everyone in line.

signs.name: Taurus
lines: You’ll stubbornly insist the movie is a masterpiece.
Even though you fell asleep halfway through.

signs.name: Gemini
lines: You’ll tweet 37 hot takes about the film’s cinematography.
Then delete them all when your mutuals roast you.

signs.name: Cancer
lines: You’ll cry during the trailer and refuse to see the movie.
It’s just too emotionally risky.

signs.name: Leo
lines: You’ll loudly declare it’s your new favorite film.
Mainly because you’re in the background of one scene.

signs.name: Virgo
lines: You’ll spend the runtime counting continuity errors.
Your spreadsheet will break IMDb.

signs.name: Libra
lines: You’ll agonize over whether to see it or not.
Then you’ll miss the theatrical run entirely.

signs.name: Scorpio
lines: You’ll write a scalding Letterboxd review.
Then send it anonymously to the director.

signs.name: Sagittarius
lines: You’ll show up to the wrong movie theater.
End up watching a documentary about llamas instead.

signs.name: Capricorn
lines: You’ll calculate the exact ROI of buying a ticket.
Then pirate it anyway.

signs.name: Aquarius
lines: You’ll organize a protest against ‘capitalist witchcraft.’
No one shows up, but you make a great TikTok.

signs.name: Pisces
lines: You’ll get lost in the lobby and miss the movie.
Somehow, you still leave with strong opinions about it.

generator.lucky_draw: Powerball-style: five distinct 1–69 (sorted) plus one Powerball 1–26; snarky one-liner via same LLM.

lucky_numbers_comment: The stars conjure up $46M like a lukewarm love potion, but your numbers—2, 27, 38, 48, 64, PB 19—might cast a luckier spell than this box office snooze-fest.
